@X04ßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßßß
@X07
         Access to the system is restricted to pre-registered callers only.
         No public access is allowed.

         Main Board-
                -Private messages between callers and Sysops only.

                -No file areas, scripts, bulletins are available.

         Employee E-Mail-
                -No file area, scripts, bulletins are available.

                -Conference is available to all employees.
                 Messaging may be either public or private.

         Sales & Marketing-
                -Access is restricted to members of the Sales & Marketing
                 Department(s).

                -Bulletins are available for display of information relating
                 specifically to this area.

                -Files areas are available for download of information
                 relating specifically to this area.

         MIS-
                -Access is restricted to members of the MIS Department.

                -Bulletins are available for display of information relating
                 specifically to this area.

                -Files areas are available for download of information
                 relating specifically to this area.

         Administration-
                -Access is restricted to members of Administration.

                -Bulletins are available for display of information relating
                 specifically to this area.

                -Files areas are available for download of information
                 relating specifically to this area.

         Human Resources-
                -Access is restricted to members of the Human Resources
                 Department.

                -Bulletins are available for display of information relating
                 specifically to this area.

                -Files areas are available for download of information
                 relating specifically to this area.

         Customer Support-
                -Access is restricted to members of the Customer Support
                 Department.

                -Bulletins are available for display of information relating
                 specifically to this area.

                -Files areas are available for download of information
                 relating specifically to this area.

         Engineering-
                -Access is restricted to members of the Engineering
                 Department.

                -Bulletins are available for display of information relating
                 specifically to this area.

                -Files areas are available for download of information
                 relating specifically to this area.
